aliases: Process in occupational health and safety

one_line_answer.text: Risk management identifies and assesses risks from hazards. Then it leads to action.

cites.quote: It serves to identify and assess the risks derived from the hazards.
It finally leads to appropriate action to reduce or even eliminate such risks.

bangla_explanation: Risk management হলো OSH-এর অবিচ্ছেদ্য অংশ; বলা হয়েছে, risk management মানেই health and safety।
চারটি ধাপ: hazard খোঁজা (identifying), risk মাপা (assessing), risk কমাতে action নেওয়া, আর action কাজ করছে কি না monitoring করা।
Monitoring দুই স্তরে: action এখনো effective কি না, আর action থেকে নতুন hazard তৈরি হলো কি না।
সব analysis, assessment আর action একটি Risk Register বা Risk Log-এ লিখে রাখতে হয়।
এক cycle শেষ হলে পরের cycle schedule করতে হয়, কারণ নতুন hazard আসতেই থাকে।

example.en: A garments factory safety team lists and rates hazards. They fix the worst first. Next month they check again.
example.bn: গার্মেন্টসে safety team hazard তালিকা করে, rate করে, সবচেয়ে বড়টি আগে ঠিক করে, পরের মাসে আবার যাচাই করে।

list_answer.title: Process of risk management in occupational health and safety

cites.quote: Identifying hazards
Assessing associated risks
Taking action to mitigate risks
Monitoring the effectiveness

items_bn: Identifying hazards — কর্মস্থলে কোথায় কী hazard আছে তা খুঁজে বের করা।
Assessing associated risks — প্রতিটি hazard থেকে risk কতটা, likelihood ও consequence দিয়ে মাপা।
Taking action to mitigate risks — risk কমাতে বা দূর করতে action নেওয়া।
Monitoring the effectiveness — action কাজ করছে কি না আর নতুন hazard এলো কি না, তা দেখা।

traps.text: Hazards and risks resulting from hazards are something different.

traps.text: Review each action on two levels. Is it still effective? Did it add a new hazard?

cites.quote: The outcome of each risk mitigating action has to be reviewed on two levels
To ensure that the actions taken are effective and continue to be effective.
To ensure that no new hazard/risk was introduced by the actions taken.

traps.text: All analysis, assessments and actions are recorded in a Risk Register or Risk Log.

cites.quote: All analysis and assessments made as well as all actions taken need to be recorded.
A Risk Register or Risk Log will serve to do so.

traps.text: The most effective action is usually also the most difficult, sometimes most expensive.

cites.quote: the most effective usually is also the most difficult and sometimes most expensive to realize

short.prompt: Write down the process of risk management in occupational health and safety.
short.modelAnswer:
Risk management is an integral part of occupational health and safety. Its process is:
1. Identifying hazards
2. Assessing associated risks
3. Taking action to mitigate risks
4. Monitoring the effectiveness
All analysis, assessments and actions are recorded in a Risk Register or Risk Log.
